name: nexus-crm
description: NEXUS sales cockpit. The shipped app is vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with no runtime dependencies. Vitest is a dev-only test runner.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp -r css dist/ && cp -r js dist/ && echo '/* /index.html 200' > dist/_redirects
scripts.build:scrm: npm run build && echo '{"version":1,"include":["/api/*","/auth/*"],"exclude":[]}' > dist/_routes.json && printf '/admin/ /admin 301\n/* /index.html 200\n' > dist/_redirects
scripts.dev: npm run build:scrm && wrangler d1 migrations apply nexus-scrm --local && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd dist && npx wrangler pages deploy . --project-name nexus-crm --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:scrm: npm run build:scrm && wrangler d1 migrations apply nexus-scrm --remote && wrangler pages deploy --project-name nexus-scrm --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:scrm
